prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a bright spring garden terrace of pale stone with blooming tulip beds, a low trimmed hedge, a standard-height garden gate and a bench, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as the figure, NO dark background NO black void, ONE person standing, the camera set back far enough that the whole figure is visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on the figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

ONE real adult American person with the face of a beautiful woman, the face exactly the same tone as the body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, sun-kissed skin, heavily sculpted contour and a strong highlighter on the cheekbones, bold defined brows, long fluffy false lashes, shimmery bronze eyeshadow, large eyes with bright real catchlights, plump glossy nude lips with a defined lip-liner outline, a confident, camera-ready smile, bold vivid tangerine-orange hair styled in low bun, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large copper hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on copper chains of different lengths (a copper hammer head, a bronze miniature anvil, a gold ship's anchor), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large rose-gold hoop carrying six heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on rose-gold chains of different lengths (a copper barrel-shaped weight, a silver square-sided cowbell, a copper pyramid-shaped lump, a tin hammer head, a tin cube-shaped block, a lead chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten rose-gold hair ornaments. Extremely long stiletto nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
Physique: the body of a tall, extraordinarily well-built athletic man, far beyond any real person in size, built like a fitness model. Broad shoulders, a full athletic chest, a lean defined abdomen with a clear eight-pack, strong toned arms, a narrow waist, and long strong toned legs with defined calves. Large and powerful in frame, yet taut, lean and elegant rather than bulky. The head stays in correct proportion to the frame; the arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
Body Art: The bare skin is painted in Spanish Andalusian filigree (a deep black ground with fine silver filigree in geometric star patterns), wide silver bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense geometric star filigree filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers the whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of the hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of the feet. The face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of the body.
Footwear: Extreme cobalt-blue platform thigh-skimming boots, the platform soles rising far higher than the ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each painted pattern catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, the face toward the camera.
